title: Wall module with a door opening, 1.0 m wide
description: A rendered wall module with a door opening 0.8 m wide and 2.0 m high that starts at the floor, from x = 0.1 to x = 0.9. The front 7 cm of the opening, from z = -0.07 to z = 0, is clear to its full 0.8 m by 2.0 m, so the door leaf fits there. Behind it, from z = -0.15 to z = -0.07, a dark aluminium frame 3 cm wide lines the two sides and the top of the opening and is the stop the door closes against. The door leaf is a separate atom and is not part of this one. The module carries the frame side of a door hinge.

reference_pack.value_or_path: Typical sizes for a two-storey Tokyo house, chosen for this test. Not measured from a real building, so record dimension_source as "estimated".
Use only library materials from assets/mat/. Give each glTF material the library ID as its name and the values in that material.json. No custom materials and no textures in this test.
The module fills a box from x = 0 to its width, y = 0 to its height and z = -depth to 0. The outer face is the z = 0 plane and faces +Z. Nothing may reach outside the box.
See connector_frames in this task. Each gives a connector's position and the directions of its +Z and +Y, in the asset's own axes (+X right, +Y up, +Z front). The validator checks them.

connector_frames.name: conn_door_hinge_a_01
connector_frames.note: The door opens outwards, towards +Z. A turn about the connector's +Y by a negative angle swings the leaf out.
